subject.title: fix(shared): cap backtick delimiter length to prevent unbounded repeat

question: What should these shared helpers do when no safe Markdown delimiter exists within the allocation bound?
rationale: Rejecting, sanitizing, or returning a non-Markdown fallback changes caller-visible behavior, while silently capping the delimiter weakens the rendering boundary.

options.title: Reject unrepresentable input
options.body: Return a typed failure or throw at a documented threshold so callers explicitly handle pathological content.

options.title: Sanitize excessive runs
options.body: Replace or truncate problematic backtick runs under a documented content-transformation contract.

options.title: Return a safe fallback
options.body: Emit escaped plain text or another non-Markdown representation that cannot terminate its container.

recommendation.title: Reject unrepresentable input
recommendation.body: Return a typed failure or throw at a documented threshold so callers explicitly handle pathological content.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available integration-routing candidate, though the precise shared-helper owner remains uncertain.
